task.goal: Get 10 iron bars banked. (1) Mine iron ore at the iron ore rocks near x 2581 z 3231, until mine_rock says every ore is at target. (2) Walk to the furnace at x 2601 z 3310 and smelt: one smelt action smelts the whole pile. (3) When you carry the iron bars still needed, walk to the bank at x 2616 z 3332, open it, deposit the iron bars, and close it. Repeat (1) to (3) until 10 iron bars are banked. If an action is refused, do what its message says. A level-up or other dialog does not stop the task: close it and carry on.

warnings: The start check does not read the pickaxe or levels: needs Mining 15, Smithing 15, and a pickaxe
